steps: Authorize a WMS bootstrap service identity and freeze one site-scoped logical snapshot watermark.
Page through Released/currently-effective WMS-relevant Sites, UOMs, conversions, material groups, Items, Item Revisions and Work Centers.
Upsert WMS projections by shared ID and aggregate version; retain WMS-owned extension fields.
Persist snapshot watermark and matching Kafka offsets in WMS sync state.
Consume events strictly after the watermark/offset and apply idempotently.
Run reconciliation before marking the site WMS_MASTER_SYNC_READY.

required_mes_interfaces.contract: site_id, object_types, effective_at, cursor, limit, watermark

bootstrap.pagination: opaque cursor; deterministic aggregate_type + aggregate_id order; bounded limit
bootstrap.filters: site scope, Released, effective_at; include inactive tombstones only for reconciliation
bootstrap.authentication: Keycloak service account through Kong or approved internal mTLS/JWT policy

reconciliation.frequency: hourly incremental plus daily full site comparison; on-demand after replay/bootstrap
reconciliation.comparison: MES signed/versioned snapshot digest or paginated reconciliation API versus WMS projection digest
reconciliation.auto_repair: replay exact event or upsert newer authoritative snapshot for non-conflicting projection gaps
reconciliation.manual_approval: identity conflict, version regression, WMS extension conflict, policy semantic conflict
reconciliation.evidence: durable run ID, site, object ID, MES/WMS versions, mismatch code, action, actor and timestamps
reconciliation.owner: MES owns source correction; WMS owns projection repair; Platform owns transport evidence
